feat: Add quiz functionality and result display
This commit introduces a simple quiz feature.

commit idea

This commit implements Retrofit to fetch and display a list of videos from a remote API.
The following changes were made: - Added Retrofit and Glide dependencies to `build.gradle.kts`. - Created `RetrofitClient` and `ApiService` for network requests. - Created `VideoItem` data class to model video data. - Created `VideoAdapter` to display videos in a RecyclerView. - Modified `MainActivity` to fetch videos using Retrofit and display them in a RecyclerView.
- Added new layout files (`item_video.xml`) and drawable resources for the video list UI. - Updated `AndroidManifest.xml` to include internet permission. - Updated `activity_main.xml` to use a RecyclerView.
added video.json file for live access

Updates Retrofit base URL and API endpoint for video data
The base URL for the Retrofit client has been changed to "https://ifahimkhan.github.io/". The API endpoint for fetching video data in `ApiService` has been updated to "/MobileApplicationDevelopment_Labwork/video.json".

enable edge-to-edge display in MainActivity
This commit enables edge-to-edge display in the `MainActivity` by calling `EdgeToEdge.enable(this)` and setting a `OnApplyWindowInsetsListener` to adjust padding for system bars. The root layout in `activity_main.xml` has also been given an ID for this purpose.

Refactor: Use ListView instead of RecyclerView for image display
This commit replaces the RecyclerView with a ListView for displaying images in the gallery. Replaces Glide with a manual image loading using bitmap to showcase the performance difference

feat: migrated image display from ListView to RecyclerView with GridLayout
This commit refactors the image display functionality: - Replaced the ListView with a RecyclerView. - Implemented a GridLayoutManager for the RecyclerView to display images in a grid with 3 columns. - Updated the ImageAdapter to extend RecyclerView.Adapter and utilize a ViewHolder pattern for improved performance. - Removed inefficient image loading options (inSampleSize) as RecyclerView handles view recycling more effectively. - Ensured compatibility with Android 13+ by requesting READ_MEDIA_IMAGES permission.

updated jdk version and added webview backpress support
The JDK version was updated from 17 to 21 in the project's configuration files. Additionally, the `MainActivity` was modified to handle the back button press within the `WebView`, allowing navigation to the previous page if available. The Javascript interface name was also changed from "Android" to "Fahim". Gradle project settings were updated to set the test runner to "CHOOSE_PER_TEST" and `resolveExternalAnnotations` was removed.

Adding radio button question to get correct answer.
This commit updates the `MainActivity` to display a question with radio button options. The selected answer is then passed to `SecondActivity` to verify and display the result.
Key changes: - Updated `MainActivity` layout to include a `TextView` for the question and a `RadioGroup` for answer options. - Implemented logic in `MainActivity` to get the selected radio button value. - Modified `SecondActivity` to receive the selected answer, display it, and indicate whether it's correct or incorrect. - Added new colors for correct and incorrect answers. - Updated project configuration files (`.idea/misc.xml`, `.idea/compiler.xml`, etc.).

This commit introduces a simple quiz feature.
- MainActivity: - Added a RadioGroup for quiz options. - Added a Spinner for subject selection. - Implemented a "Submit" button to navigate to SecondActivity. - Passes the selected answer and subject to SecondActivity via Intent. - SecondActivity: - Displays the selected answer and subject received from MainActivity. - Changes the text color to green for the correct answer ("James Gosling") and red otherwise. - Layouts: - Updated activity_main.xml to include RadioGroup, Spinner, and Button. - Created activity_second.xml to display the result. - Resources: - Added green and red color definitions in colors.xml. - Manifest: - Declared SecondActivity in AndroidManifest.xml. - Project Configuration: - Updated JDK version to 21 in misc.xml and compiler.xml. - Updated deployment target selector and gradle settings.
